stow: Bundle the module graph rooted at `entry` for `target`, writing a harness plus bundle to `out`.
Target: A bundling target, such as `bare-sidecar` or `bare-worker`, describing how to package and boot a bundle on a given host runtime.
Target.name: The target's name.
Target.linked: Whether the bundle links against its dependencies rather than inlining them.
Target.offload: Whether native addons and/or assets are written out as sibling files instead of being inlined into the bundle.
Target.format: The encoding format of the written bundle artifact.
Target.encoding: The text encoding used when the bundle format wraps the bundle as a string, or `null` when the bundle is written as raw bytes.
Target.extension: The file extension used for the target's harness artifact.
Target.module: The module system the harness is generated in, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`. When unset, it follows the output path's extension or nearest `package.json` `type`.
Target.hosts: The host triples the target supports.
TargetContext: The context passed to a target's `generate()`, describing the bundle to embed and the RPC wiring to splice in.
TargetContext.bundleSpecifier: The module specifier the harness uses to load the bundle, relative to the harness itself.
TargetContext.ipc: The identifier bound to the IPC stream in generated harness code.
TargetContext.rpc: The identifier bound to the RPC client/server in generated harness code.
TargetContext.module: The module system the harness is generated in, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`.
TargetContext.client: The resolved client RPC wiring to splice into the harness, or `null` when no client RPC was requested.
RPC: An RPC library adapter that generates the wiring code spliced into a stowed bundle's harness or entry shim.
RPC.name: The RPC adapter's name.
RPC.generate: Generate the RPC wiring artifacts for `context`.
RPCContext: The context passed to an RPC adapter's `generate()`.
RPCContext.ipc: The identifier bound to the IPC stream in generated code.
RPCContext.rpc: The identifier bound to the RPC client/server in generated code.
RPCContext.module: The module system the generated code targets, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`.
RPCContext.role: Whether the generated wiring is for the `'client'` (harness side) or `'server'` (bundle entry shim side).
RPCClient: The resolved client RPC wiring, carrying both the runtime source to splice into the harness and the type declaration to splice into the harness's `.d.ts`.
RPCClient.source: The generated runtime source for the client RPC wiring.
RPCClient.type: The generated type declaration for the client RPC wiring.
Artifact: A single generated source artifact, such as a harness or a type declaration.
Artifact.extension: The file extension the artifact should be written with alongside the primary output, or unset to write it to the primary output path itself.
StowOptions.client: The RPC library (or its name) to wire into the harness.
StowOptions.server: The RPC library (or its name) to wire into the bundle's entry shim.
StowOptions.resolveTarget: Resolve a target name to a `Target`, overriding the default target resolution.
StowOptions.resolveRPC: Resolve an RPC name to an `RPC`, overriding the default RPC resolution.
StowArtifact: An artifact written by `stow()`, yielded once its file has been written.
StowArtifact.url: The file URL the artifact was written to.
Protocol: A duplex stream over `bare-stow`'s host/worker wire protocol, multiplexing a control channel (lifecycle frames like `ready`, `exit`, `error`, `terminate`) alongside a user data channel.
Protocol.constructor: Attach a `Protocol` to the given underlying duplex byte `stream`.
Protocol.send: Send a control frame of `type` with an optional JSON-serializable `payload`.
attach: Attach a `Protocol` to `stream`, an underlying duplex byte stream.
ProtocolEvents: The events emitted by a `Protocol`, in addition to the standard duplex stream events.
ProtocolEvents.ready: Emitted when the worker signals it is ready.
ProtocolEvents.terminate: Emitted when a `terminate` control frame is received.
ProtocolEvents.exit: Emitted when the worker signals exit, carrying its exit `code`.
CONTROL: The frame type marker identifying a control-channel frame.
USER: The frame type marker identifying a user-data-channel frame.
wrap: Wrap the host side of a stowed bundle's transport `stream`, returning an `IPC` handle with lifecycle helpers layered on top of the `Protocol`.
IPC: The host-side handle for a stowed bundle's transport, layering a `ready` promise and a `terminate()` method on top of `Protocol`.
IPC.constructor: Wrap the host side of a stowed bundle's transport `stream`.
IPC.ready: A promise that resolves once the worker has signaled ready, and rejects if the worker errors before then.
IPC.terminate: Send a `terminate` control frame to the worker and resolve with its exit code once it exits.
